auth.description: Users sign in with an existing DealHound Pro license key (Ed25519, verified offline). No key = free tier. Nothing is sold inside the plugin.

commerce_compliance.policy_basis: OpenAI plugin app guidelines §1.4 (see connector-portfolio/chatgpt-plugin-readiness.md). Re-verify against live docs before submission.
rules_enforced: No in-plugin checkout, pricing display, or plan/upgrade promotion.
Free-tier cap blocks return a neutral message; the engine's upgrade_prompt() (price + Stripe link) is never surfaced.
Pro is honored via sign-in to an existing license key, never sold in-plugin.
Affiliate links DISABLED by default (DEALHOUND_PLUGIN_AFFILIATE=1 to enable). Zero monetized links until OpenAI confirms the affiliate policy.

description: Tell it what you want once — DealHound watches 24/7. An always-on deal watcher for your dot: name a brand, category, or keyword plus your target price, and scheduled checks plus event triggers scan deal sources around the clock. Matches land as alerts with price, discount, merchant, and link. Your sidebar panel shows the live watchlist.
example_prompts: Tell me when Nike Pegasus drops below €100
Watch for a 4K monitor deal under $300 and alert me
Let me know if espresso machines go on sale this week
Track LEGO Star Wars sets and ping me on price drops
Are there any price drops on running shoes right now?
Add Sony headphones to my deal watchlist

mcp.transport: stdio (local dev build). Production: streamable-HTTP on a public HTTPS domain — NOT YET PROVISIONED (blocker).

name: dealhound

positioning.category_note: Validated price-tracker category (Honey / CamelCamelCamel proved the demand); no dominant always-on equivalent in the ChatGPT plugin directory.
positioning.differentiator: DOTS-NATIVE. Not a chat plugin you query — an always-on watcher. The user tells their dot once; the dot, MCP Events, and scheduled tasks watch 24/7; the sidebar panel shows the live watchlist.
positioning.scheduled_tasks: ChatGPT Scheduled Tasks invoke deal_scan on the user's cadence (daily digest on free, high-frequency on Pro) — no polling infrastructure of our own.

tools.description: Add a brand, category, or keyword to the always-on deal watchlist.
tools.name: watchlist_add

tools.description: Remove a brand, category, or keyword from the deal watchlist.
tools.name: watchlist_remove

tools.description: List the current deal watchlist (brands, categories, keywords) — the live view for the sidebar panel.
tools.name: watchlist_list

tools.description: Run one watch cycle: scan deal sources for price drops matching the watchlist (or a one-off query). Invoked by scheduled tasks and event triggers. Returns ranked matches with price, discount, merchant, reasons, and link.
tools.name: deal_scan

tools.description: Sign in with an existing DealHound Pro license key (from a purchase made on the DealHound website). The key is verified offline; nothing is sold here.
tools.name: account_signin

tools.description: Sign out of the DealHound account on this device.
tools.name: account_signout

tools.description: Show account state: tier, watchlist usage, alert cadence.
tools.name: account_status

tools.description: Get or set deal alert filters: minimum discount percent, maximum price, maximum listing age in days. These are the thresholds the always-on watcher checks against.
tools.name: alert_prefs
